$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the care pack composed with a women's health practice content seed, re-registered in the seaglass register (sea glass and sand, terracotta, a narrow modern serif, stage cards under arched photographs) with its own pinned page skeletons. Everything else — pages' builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: OB/GYN & Women's Health
description: An OB/GYN practice's site with real online booking: Solana Women's Health, a four-physician practice on Ocean Avenue in Santa Monica, art-directed in sea glass and sand with terracotta — a narrow modern serif with a true italic over a quiet grotesk (real web fonts). The hero: a full-bleed photograph of a laughing expectant mother and her OB in an ocean-view suite, the headline in ink on the pale wall. Under it, five life-stage cards under arched photographs — annual care, fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, midlife — each with its emblem and what it covers. Self-pay prices, the plans the practice takes, a prenatal spotlight, the physicians as round medallions, patients' words, questions, and the visit panel follow.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these practice and appointments seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins) — the composed template's Manage editors and booking widget open on the orthodontic studio, not the base clinic.

providers.name: Alisha Patel, MD
providers.bio: Alisha founded Solana after a decade of fifteen-minute visits at a big hospital group. She sees annual care, contraception and the hard conversations, and keeps an hour free every week for the patients who need more time.

providers.name: Claire Anderson, MD
providers.bio: Claire runs the practice's fertility consults and preconception planning and delivers most of the babies who started with her. She draws everything on the whiteboard, twice.

providers.name: Maya Ellison, MD
providers.bio: Maya splits her week between prenatal care and perimenopause, and is certified in menopause medicine. Patients say she is the first doctor who explained their symptoms instead of listing them.

providers.name: Sophia Reyes, MD
providers.bio: Sophia handles the practice's procedures, from IUDs to laparoscopic surgery, and sees endometriosis and fibroid care. She sees patients in English and Spanish.

services.name: Annual care
services.description: Well-woman exams, screenings, contraception and the questions you've been saving, in a visit that isn't rushed.

services.name: Fertility
services.description: Preconception counseling, ovarian reserve testing, and egg-freezing consults, with a plan you can read.

services.name: Pregnancy & birth
services.description: Prenatal care from the first heartbeat, your birth plan in writing, and delivery with a physician you know.

services.name: Postpartum
services.description: Fourth-trimester visits, lactation support and mental health screening, for as long as the recovery takes.

services.name: Midlife & menopause
services.description: Perimenopause, hormone therapy and bone health, with a physician certified in menopause medicine.

services.name: Gynecologic surgery
services.description: IUD placement, fibroid and endometriosis care, and minimally invasive surgery with a short recovery.

newPatient.body: Pick a physician and a time. New patients usually see someone the same week.

newPatient.title: A plan in writing
newPatient.body: You leave with what we found, what's next, and any costs spelled out, plus a direct line to your care team.

theme.$comment: The seaglass register in its own terracotta: mode light opens the site in its native appearance (the sand ground); dark is the practice after sunset over the water. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks pages and app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared careShell chrome to the inline bar — the practice's letterhead over the coast — apart from bright-side's pill cluster, atwater's split letterhead and fern & finch's centered title plate.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the seaglass register, and pages carries exactly the skeletons careLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the full-bleed hero because home.layout asks for it, the stage cards (exhibits) because home fills them, and the content-gated sections (menu, spotlight, faq) because the seed writes them — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/Care/careLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
